newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss Feb inflation steady at 0.8 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss Feb inflation steady at 0.8 pct yr/yr.

text.p: Swiss consumer prices rose 0.2 percent in February from the previous month for a year-on-year inflation rate of 0.8 percent, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Monthly CPI index change +0.2 pct +0.3 pct +0.2 pct

It attributed most of the monthly rise to the category "other goods and services", which was up 0.7 percent due to higher seasonal prices for group tours and lodging. Prices for transport and commnunications also rose, up 0.3 percent.
Prices for food, drinks and tobacco were up 0.2 percent, while those for rents and energy as well as for clothing and shoes were practically stable, it said.

Prices for domestic goods rose 0.1 percent in the month and 0.7 percent year on year. Prices for imports were up 0.3 percent in the month and 1.3 percent for the year, primarily because of higher oil prices.
It said fuel prices rose 1.5 percent since January and 9.5 percent compared with February 1996.
